text_block_list.name: Newscaster
text_block_list.text:
—Next up is our special feature.
Dubai, the scorching nation. A country where numerous historic races have taken place...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Dubai, huh~!
...I see, I see!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
What's this~? A special feature on Dubai?
Ah, a racetrack! The grandstand is gorgeous~!
It's huuuuge♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Us too, us too~.
Yep, gathering intel is the basics, you know~? ♪
The race begins before you even step on the track. Boom!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I understand. Fatigue and stress from
long-distance travel and an unfamiliar environment
can be a massive disadvantage, after all...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard you train,
there's no guarantee you'll perform at your best on race day...
There are so many obstacles when competing overseas, aren't there?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Fufufu, in that case... how about a "simulated experience" with a trip to Tomakomai?!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: A simulated experience...?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I thought if I traveled long distances by plane, I might get a bit more used to it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Tomakomai's climate is completely different
from Tokyo's, and the water tastes different too.
There are rare foods, as well.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What do you think~? I'm a local idol after all,
so gotta promote Tomakomai at every chance☆
Just kidding—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
…………
Ain't that pretty good? Seriously.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeeeek!! Even for me!?
I'm not worthy! I am so blessed and honored~~~!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, let's hurry~.
We've got no time to waste on a lightning day trip♪"
choice_data_list: Everyone~ The rental car is ready~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Trainer-san,
thank you for chaperoning us!
I look forward to working with you today!

A long-distance trip as a 'simulated overseas expedition'...
That actually sounds really promising!
Let's give it our full support today!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"First up is a li~ght stroll!
Walking through a nature park will refresh that travel fatigue!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Inhaaale, the air tastes so good~.
I've been sitting down forever, so this brings me right back to life~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit chillier than Tokyo...
Dressing appropriately really is key when traveling.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
With the famous surf clam curry,
we can simulate eating unfamiliar food!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
That had a unique taste, but so yummy~♪
With this kinda stuff, whoever enjoys it the most wins, y'know?
What else ya got~? Anything rare?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haskap salmon roe miso ramennn...!?
Digitan is gonna go for it!
Even if it's a disaster, it'll make good content! Here goes!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... What an incredible view...!
We crossed this entire ocean to get here, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: “Yeah, it really feels like we've come a long way. Well then, for the finale, let's run across the sand with all our might!”

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ran my heart out! I wonder if this is what it feels like to train on your first day abroad...?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Indeed, it really flexes the imagination, doesn't it? Just close your eyes, and you're already in Dubai...! Dreamy Dubai...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it certainly makes you feel that way, doesn't it?
I wonder... will we truly be able to go someday?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You can do it, no problem.
Give it everything you've got, and there's no reason you can't.
After all, all the oceans are connected.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"You're right...!
Hehe, I bet seeing the real sunset in Dubai will be even more breathtaking..."
choice_data_list: You guys can definitely do it.
You guys can definitely do it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I think so too...!
I'm sure everyone can make it happen...!

And so, our day trip to Tomakomai drew to a close.
Today's youth will surely lead into tomorrow's dreams.
We gained so much from this...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: “—Thank you sooo very much for hanging out with me today!”
choice_data_list: You really gave it your all and had a blast, huh!
You really gave it your all and had fun, didn't you!
Let's put this experience to good use when we go on the overseas campaign.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: “—Thank you sooo very much for hanging out with me today!”
choice_data_list: You really gave it your all and had a blast, huh!
You really gave it your all and had fun, didn't you!
Let's put this experience to good use when we go on the overseas campaign.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm completely exhausted.
An actual overseas expedition
must be even tougher...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm gonna give it even more effort!
To let the whole world know the name of Tomakomai♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, if I get used to it like this, I'll be one step closer to my dream.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: If the day comes when I race in Dubai, I want to run with absolutely zero regrets!
